description: Temporal sweep suites rerun on the IntToFP, 74266 and 7476 fixtures (FIXTURES) after #380 and #381 followed Evolution changes made after the pin. Compared against a d58a61e0 JAR built on Windows; the receipt of temporal-kinds names the macOS JAR, which was not available.

suites.command: FIXTURES='(inttofp|ttl_74266|ttl_7476)(__.*)?' scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/default CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify evolution-followups-d58a61e0 --suites default)

FIXTURES='(inttofp|ttl_74266|ttl_7476)(__.*)?' scripts/oracle/temporal-kinds/run.sh --variants EVOLUTION_JAR WORK/variants CORE_JAR (python3 scripts/parity_matrix.py reverify evolution-followups-d58a61e0 --suites variants)
